answer: The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, published publicly on failure. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The nadir is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the umber. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Reaching the meadow of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
